citations.text: J. Lange, J. Gückel, P. Fontaine, T. Gschwind (2025). CLLIB: a benchmark library for two-tier city logistics. Zenodo.

description: CLLIB, a benchmark library of two-tier city logistics planning instances for Karlsruhe Oststadt, Ingolstadt and Munich, with distribution centres, road and rail satellites, customers, demands with time windows, a travel time matrix, candidate tours and services, and the parameters each instance was generated with; distributed as sub-libraries (Small, Medium, Large, by city and by demand type) of one JSON file per instance. tasks/v1 would hold the distribution centres, satellites and customers as nodes; the tours, services and travel times have no place in it.
name: CLLIB: two-tier city logistics benchmark library

recipe.reason: An instance is one JSON object whose locations sit beneath `locations`, then their kind (`dc`, `sat`, `cust`), then their number, beside top-level arrays (the travel time matrix, demands, tours, services) and a parameter object, and each location's coordinates are a two-element array; the json-table parser's nested layout reads records beneath uniform keys with scalar fields, so it can neither descend into `locations` alone nor read the coordinates, and keepset has no CLLIB instance parser.
